subject: Linguistics
title: Chinese Characters
description: A short lesson to help you apply Chinese Characters.

hook.text: A single Chinese character can be 3,000 years old—and still used in today's text messages.

buildup.text: Chinese characters evolved from oracle bone inscriptions into the standardized forms used today.

discovery.text: About 80% of characters are phono-semantic compounds—one part hints at meaning, another at sound.

twist.text: Japan, Korea, and Vietnam all adopted Chinese characters—adapting them to very different languages.

climax.text: Simplified characters were introduced in mainland China in the 1950s to boost literacy rates.

punchline.text: Old bones still speak through today's characters.

quiz.question: What are phono-semantic compounds?
options: Characters with parts hinting at both meaning and sound
